Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the cipher registry records each claim and the grove audit publishes every slash. Attesters sign a declaration that they hold no common funding with the identity they attest, and a later finding of common funding voids the attestation and slashes 50% of the attester's bond.
